title: fix(plugin-grid): list grid row actions trigger visible at rest in a muted tone
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbYXRisiPeY3Ds8vvkqmFfEg)_

Fixes #28871

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:列表表格「操作」列里每行的 ⋯ 按钮,静止时也画出来(灰色弱化色),鼠标移到该行、行内获得焦点、行被选中、按钮自己获得键盘焦点、菜单打开时,或在触屏上,变为正常前景色。菜单里有哪些项、各项的显示条件和顺序都不变。
- **为什么改**:表头「操作」一直在,但桌面端按钮在鼠标移上行之前是透明的,整列看起来是空的,读者会以为「没有可用操作」。
- **风险与回滚**:只改 `ui/packages/plugin-grid` 一个组件里那个按钮的样式类,不动 spec、服务端、元数据和菜单逻辑。弱化色用的是文字色(`text-muted-foreground`),不是透明度,对比度与其它次要图标一致。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx` 里 `data-testid="row-action-trigger"` 那个按钮的 `className`;再看新测试 `RowActionMenu.atRest-28871.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/components/__tests__/RowActionMenu.atRest-28871.test.tsx`,应 1 个文件 4 个用例全部通过;或在 Console 打开线索列表(1440 px),不移动鼠标就能看到每行的 ⋯。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`RowActionMenu`'s ⋯ trigger (`data-testid="row-action-trigger"`, the one the list grid's `_actions` column draws per row):

- **At rest:** drawn on every row, on every pointer type, in `text-muted-foreground`. The `opacity-0` / `transition-opacity` pair is gone, so nothing hides the trigger before the pointer reaches the row.
- **Full strength (`text-foreground`)** on row hover (`group-hover/row`), focus within the row (`group-focus-within/row`), a selected row (`group-data-[state=selected]/row`), an open menu (`data-[state=open]`), its own keyboard focus (`focus-visible`) and a coarse pointer (`pointer-coarse`), which cannot hover.
- The tone is a text colour, not an opacity, so the resting glyph keeps the same contrast as every other muted secondary icon. The ghost variant's own `hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground` still applies when the pointer is on the button itself.

Unchanged: the menu's items, their gates and their order (`useRowActionPlan`, #28434), the inline primary buttons, the empty-menu guard (no trigger when the plan offers nothing), the header (`objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` is not touched), the 44 px touch target, and the accessible name. No key, option or prop is added.

## Tests

- `RowActionMenu.atRest-28871.test.tsx` (new, 4 cases, `dom` project). jsdom applies no stylesheet, so visibility is read off the classes that decide it, as `data-table-leadingCell-12423.test.tsx` does:
  - at rest the trigger carries no `opacity-0` (under any variant), `invisible`, `hidden` or `sr-only`, and keeps its accessible name;
  - it rests in `text-muted-foreground` and carries the five full-strength variants;
  - the only `pointer-coarse:` class is `pointer-coarse:text-foreground`, so a coarse pointer strengthens the tone and is never what makes the trigger appear;
  - control: opening the menu flips the trigger's `data-state` to `open` (the state `data-[state=open]:` keys on) and shows the item.

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, at 7d467519, source-resolved, no dist)</summary>

- `opacity-0` put back at rest (`text-muted-foreground transition-colors` to `text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-colors`): 1 failed ("is drawn at rest: nothing hides it before the pointer reaches the row"), 3 passed. Restored, blob `adea0869` equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The coarse-pointer leg put back to an opacity reveal (`pointer-coarse:text-foreground` to `pointer-coarse:opacity-100`): 1 failed (the every-pointer-type case), 3 passed. Restored, blob `adea0869` equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` draws its own row-actions trigger (`data-testid="data-table-row-actions"`, the generic `data-table` renderer's schema `rowActions`) with the old `opacity-0` set, pinned by `data-table-leadingCell-12423.test.tsx`. It is not the list grid's trigger and is outside this card's file surface, so it keeps hover-reveal. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewOpenAsPage.tsx` has a separate hover-revealed control in the same style, also untouched.
- The enlarged related tab inherits this once it draws `object-grid` (#28865), with no change here.

## Verification

All on the final head `7d467519` (base `origin/main` `b15b634c`), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...'` plus formula, sdui-parser, lint and client (49 tasks, exit 0), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- The whole `packages/plugin-grid/` vitest suite (`--maxWorkers=2`): 271 files, 2353 tests passed. The five `RowActionMenu*` files alone: 81 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid run type-check` (both `tsc` programs, the test one included): exit 0.
- ESLint on the two changed tsx files: exit 0, no findings.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 34 of 34 run, each exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the lock; the latter 169 files passed, 2 skipped), including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and the PR-body gates with this body as `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`. `--ran` reconciles 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check-partof-closing-keyword` with `PR_BODY`: exit 0. `ui` `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- Not run locally: the other packages whose tests click `row-action-trigger` (plugin-view, plugin-designer, app-shell). They find the trigger by test id and never read its classes; CI's Test UI runs them.
